SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7793
Section 1, Special Br. S/4147
REPORT
Date February 24. 19 37

Subject Communication dated 9.2.37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
regarding Miss Alexandra Eichenbaum.
Made by D.S.I. Makaroff Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

Miss Alexandra Michailovna Eichenbaum, Russian Jewess,
was born on December 29, 1907 at Warsaw, Poland.
In 1918 she came to Shanghai from Harbin together with
her father and has since been residing in this city. She
received her education in one of the local convents.
From 1926 to 1928 she was employed as a steno-typist
with Brewer & Co., Manufacturing Chemists and Wholesale
Druggists, 5 Szechuen Road. Towards the end of 1928 the
above company went into liquidation and Miss Eichenbaum
secured the position of a secretary with Messrs. Swain & Co.,
Leaf Tobacco Dealers, No. 1 Canton Road, in which capacity
she worked for the following two years.
During the period from 1932 to 1934 she worked with
the Carolina Leaf Tobacco Co., 3 Museum Road, after which she
joined the Australian Produce Co., 320 Szechuen Road, where
she was employed until 1935. From 1935 to the end of 1936
she held the position of a secretary with the Sherwin Williams
Co., 113 Kiukiang Road.
Miss Eichenbaum's present employer, Mr. W.E. Haarmann,
is known to the local German Consulate-General as a general
manufacturers' representative in the Far East who occasionally
visits Shanghai in the course of his business. It is reported
that he was divorced or is living separately from his wife,
an American. Nothing detrimental is known by the Consulate
regarding him.
Miss Eichenbaum's father, who was a well known local
merchant, died about two years ago in Hongkong.
She is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Naulmein Road.

事由：荷兰总领事馆于1937年2月9日发出的关于亚历山德拉·艾兴鲍姆小姐（Miss Alexandra Eichenbaum）的公函。
由警探长马卡罗夫（D.S.I. Makaroff）撰写，由J.博因（J. Boyne）警探长转呈。

亚历山德拉·米哈伊洛夫娜·艾兴鲍姆（Alexandra Michailovna Eichenbaum）小姐，俄罗斯犹太裔女性，于1907年12月29日出生于波兰华沙。
1918年，她与父亲一同从哈尔滨来到上海，此后一直居住在本市。她在本地的一所女修道院学校接受教育。
1926年至1928年间，她受雇于四川路5号的布鲁尔公司（Brewer & Co.，制造化学家及批发药剂师），担任速记打字员。1928年底，上述公司进入清算程序，艾兴鲍姆小姐在广东路1号的斯温公司（Messrs. Swain & Co.，烟叶经销商）获得秘书职位，在此岗位上工作了随后的两年。
1932年至1934年期间，她在博物馆路3号的卡罗莱纳烟叶公司（Carolina Leaf Tobacco Co.）工作，之后加入四川路320号的澳大利亚农产品公司（Australian Produce Co.），在那里工作至1935年。从1935年到1936年底，她在九江路113号的宣伟公司（Sherwin Williams Co.）担任秘书。
艾兴鲍姆小姐目前的雇主W.E.哈尔曼先生（Mr. W.E. Haarmann）为当地德国总领事馆所熟知，系远东地区的通用制造商代表，因业务需要偶尔访问上海。据报，他已离婚或与其美国籍妻子分居。领事馆方面未掌握有关他的任何不利信息。
艾兴鲍姆小姐的父亲是当地知名商人，约两年前在香港去世。
她已在穆明路118/1号的俄罗斯移民委员会登记注册。

February 25 37.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 485, dated 9th February, 1937, and to inform you
that Miss Alexandra Michailovna Eichenbaum, Russian
Jewess, was born on December 20, 1907, at Warsaw, Poland.
She came to Shanghai from Harbin in 1918 and has since
been residing in this city. She is registered with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, 114/1 Moulmein Road.
From 1926 until the end of 1936, she was employed as
a steno-typist or secretary with various local firms,
including the Carolina Leaf Tobacco Co., 3 Museum Road,
the Australian Produce Co., 320 Szechuen Road, and
Sherwin Williams Co., 115 Nanking Road. Her present
employer, Mr. W.H. Haarmann, is known to the local
German Consulate-General as a general manufacturers'
representative in the Far East and occasionally visits
Shanghai in the course of his business.

Miss Eichenbaum's father was a well known local
merchant who died in Hongkong about ten years ago.

Nothing is known against Miss Eichenbaum either
politically or criminally.

I have the honour to be
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔此处转录不清〕

1937年2月25日。

致 J.范登伯格先生（J. Van den Berg, Esq.），
荷兰总领事馆，
上海。

先生：

谨此提及阁下于1937年2月9日发出的第485号信函，并告知阁下，亚历山德拉·米哈伊洛夫娜·艾兴鲍姆小姐，俄罗斯犹太裔女性，于1907年12月20日出生于波兰华沙。
她于1918年从哈尔滨来到上海，此后一直居住在本市。她已在穆明路114/1号的俄罗斯移民委员会登记注册。
从1926年至1936年底，她受雇于本地多家商行，担任速记打字员或秘书，其中包括博物馆路3号的卡罗莱纳烟叶公司、四川路320号的澳大利亚农产品公司，以及南京路115号的宣伟公司。她目前的雇主W.H.哈尔曼先生（Mr. W.H. Haarmann）为当地德国总领事馆所熟知，系远东地区的通用制造商代表，因业务需要偶尔访问上海。

艾兴鲍姆小姐的父亲是当地知名商人，约十年前在香港去世。

在政治或刑事方面，未发现对艾兴鲍姆小姐不利的记录。

谨致
敬礼，
您顺从的仆人，

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 485.

SHANGHAI, 9th February 1937 .

〔右上角框内文字：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. I. REGISTRY / No S. B. D. 2293 / Date 16 2 37〕

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Miss Alexandra
Eichenbaum has applied to this Consulate for a visé for
admission into the Netherlands Indies.

She is in possession of a passport No.311884/7298
issued by the Bureau of Public Safety at Shanghai on the
17th June 1936.

According to her passport she was born in Warsaw in
1907.

She states to be secretary to Mr.W.E.Haarmann, a German,
who is a factory representative for the Far East.

Miss Eichenbaum resides in Shanghai at 1377 Avenue
Road, apartment 315, and intends to leave for Manilla at
the end of this month together with Mr.Haarmann.

They will stay for about 2 weeks only in the Netherlands
Indies.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against her
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Consul.

Majour K.M.Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

编号 485.

上海，1937年2月9日。

〔右上角框内文字：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 情报科登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. 2293 / 日期 37年2月16日〕

先生：

谨此通知阁下，亚历山德拉·艾兴鲍姆小姐已向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度群岛的入境签证。

她持有由上海公安局于1936年6月17日签发的护照，号码为311884/7298。

根据其护照记载，她于1907年出生在华沙。

她自称是德国人W.E.哈尔曼先生（Mr.W.E.Haarmann）的秘书，后者是远东地区的工厂代表。

艾兴鲍姆小姐现居住于上海爱文义路1377号315室，并计划与本月底与哈尔曼先生一同前往马尼拉。

他们在荷属东印度群岛仅停留约两周。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握有关她的任何不利信息，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕
领事。

K.M.伯恩少校（Majour K.M.Bourne），
特别科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
